# Moretta

> Moretta is a private AI chat on Solana. Users sign in with a Solana wallet, chat with the AI model of their choice, make images and videos with dozens of image and video models, compare two to four image models on one prompt, attach their own images to a prompt, make a short meme video of a Solana token from its contract address, research Solana tokens and wallets with an AI agent, and keep their chat history, images, and videos in the browser. Holders of $MORETTA get a tank of free credit that fills by $1 every hour while they hold at least $10 of $MORETTA, up to $24. The app is live at https://app.moretta.ai.

## Docs

- [What is Moretta](what-is-moretta.md): the chat, images (the image models, the aspect ratios, and the price of an image), compare mode (one prompt to two to four image models, with the images side by side), videos (the video models, the lengths, sound, the price of a video, and how long a video takes), attached images (what each mode does with them, the limits, and the price), Meme mode, onchain research, the models, and the wallet sign-in.
- [The tank](tank.md): the line ($10), the hourly fill ($1), the cap ($24), how the app values a holding, and how the chat spends credit on answers, images, compare mode, videos, and meme videos.
- [Privacy](privacy.md): where chat history, images, attached images, and videos live, what the server keeps while a video is made, what Meme mode reads about a token, what the Moretta server keeps, and the Private and Anonymous model labels.
- [The token](token.md): $MORETTA on Solana, on pump.fun, the contract address, and its official sources.
- [FAQ](faq.md): short answers to common questions.
- [Onchain research](onchain-research.md): the AI agent that reads Solana chain data with read-only tools, at most 6 tools for one question and 60 a day for one wallet. Live: find token, token info, top holders, market, wallet overview, dev check, trading flow (buys, sales, volume, and price change by window, and the latest 100 trades of the main pool with the signs of wash trading), copycat check (tokens with the same ticker or name, the oldest first), social age (the age of the website domain), wallet PnL (profit and loss, win rate, tokens traded, average hold time, best and worst positions), top traders (the 10 wallets with the most profit on a token, and whether they still hold it), smart wallets (wallets with at least $50,000 of lifetime profit across at least 20 tokens, a return of at least 20%, and at least $500 of profit a token, plus KOL wallets), and a safety report with 11 green, yellow, and red signals (mint and freeze, risky extensions, top 10 wallets, bundled at launch, snipers still hold, largest cluster, fresh wallets, dev wallet, dev history, sell test, liquidity), their thresholds, and a verdict that never calls a token safe. The tools run on the Moretta server, so the data services never see the user. Coming soon: holder growth, and the age of an X account.
- [Meme mode](meme-mode.md): a short video of the meme of a Solana token. The user pastes the contract address, with an optional idea of up to 300 characters. The Moretta server reads the token (name, ticker, description, image, the 24-hour price change, and the title and description of up to 2 of its websites), Gemini 3.8 Flash writes a new scene (one of 10 styles, a place, an action, and a camera move), Nano Banana 2 draws the first frame from the image of the token, and a video model that starts from an image animates it (Veo is left out). The server adds the Moretta mark in a corner and an end card of 2 seconds with the ticker and the contract address. The browser keeps the recipes of the last 6 meme videos of a token, so the next video differs. Real, identifiable people are turned down; a realistic character passes only when the token presents it as made-up or made with AI. The price is the video from an image, the first frame (about $0.067), and the scene (about $0.002), paid from the tank.
- [Payments](payments.md): free credit from the tank, and the next development: private top-ups on Starknet, anonymous vouchers, pay with SOL or ZEC, and private billing.
